content_of_post_to_answer: Can a stable mind exist without balance?
answer: Stability doesn't always come from balance; sometimes it comes from knowing what to anchor to when everything is moving. Balance can imply equal control over every part of life, but a stable mind may simply have a clear center. I've written more about this pattern on my profile for those who want to explore it further. The deeper truth is that stability is not the absence of disturbance; it is the ability to return without losing yourself.
